title: Studio metadata forms: `新建软件包` shows `输入无效` before any input, help text stays English in a Chinese console, and a toast covers the publish button
body:
Studio metadata forms: `新建软件包` shows `输入无效` on every required field before the author types anything, and its help text is English inside a Chinese console

Measured on `17.1.0` (open edition, `objectstack dev`), Studio → package menu → **新建软件包(可写 base)**.

## 1. Errors before input

The dialog opens with the validation already failed:

```
显示名称 *   name
             Human-readable package name
             输入无效            ← before a single keystroke
软件包 ID *  id
             Unique package identifier (reverse domain style)
             输入无效            ← same
```

Nothing has been touched. Required-field validation is running on mount instead of on blur/submit, so the author's first impression of the form is two red errors they did not cause. It also moves the layout as it clears — each field jumps by ~one line height the moment it becomes valid, which is enough to make a click land on the wrong control while filling the form top to bottom.

## 2. Mixed languages in one line

Labels are translated, the help text under them is not, and both render together:

| label (zh) | help (en) |
|---|---|
| 显示名称 | Human-readable package name |
| 软件包 ID | Unique package identifier (reverse domain style) |
| 对象命名空间 | Short namespace identifier; also the mandatory prefix of every object name (e.g. "todo" → object names "todo_task", "todo_project") |
| 版本 | Package version (semantic versioning) |
| 类型 | Type of package |
| 描述 | Package description |

The same split shows up elsewhere in the metadata console — the object form builder lists `所有者` next to `Owning Business Unit` and `Search Index`, and the flow node palette is fully Chinese except for one entry:

```
…
等待        等待事件或定时器
结束        终止流程
Revise Window   Durable pause an approval send-back parks the run on while the submitter
                reworks the record. Continues only through the approvals service (resubmit),
                which re-enters the approval node over the declared back-edge.
```

— an English name and a three-line English paragraph in a list where every other item is a Chinese name and a short Chinese phrase.

## 3. The publish panel's primary button sits under the toast

**发布 → 待发布的变更** panel: the footer explains *"发布将带来一次性(原子地)发布此包全部 1 个待发布草稿"* and carries **全部发布**. A toast from the preceding save (`对象「…」已存为草稿`) renders bottom-right, directly over that footer, and covers the button until it times out.

## Expected

- Validate on blur/submit, not on mount.
- Feed the metadata-admin form generator's `description`/help strings through the same i18n bundle the labels already use — and add `Revise Window`'s node name and description to it.
- Keep toasts clear of the panel footer (or anchor the publish action above the toast layer).
